info.title: jeeves-server
info.description: Machine API of the jeeves-server service: the routes in its endpoint catalog (SERVER_CATALOG). Credentials: an insider, machine or share key as the k query parameter, or the jeeves_session cookie; the key-exchange routes take the raw machine seed in X-API-Key. Operations marked x-jeeves-insider-only refuse share credentials.
